headlines.title: Lowe's makes major Black Friday changes shoppers should know
headlines.summary: Lowe’s is expanding its holiday savings events and offering exclusive perks to rewards members.

headlines.title: What Could Derail Lowe's Stock?
headlines.summary: Investors holding Lowe's Companies (LOW) shares have lost about 18% over the past twelve months, while the S&P 500 returned about 18%. Management noted cautious customers during its fiscal Q2 2026 earnings call. Executives also described heightened competitive pressure in July, driven by promotions that Lowe’s chose not to match in full. So what was that pressure, and where did it come from.

headlines.title: Lowe’s Dividend Sustainability Looks Solid, but Returns Face a Test
headlines.summary: Lowe’s Companies, Inc. (NYSE:LOW) runs a resilient business, thanks to its wide network of stores, strong customer relationships, and a growing focus on professional contractors. The company’s long history of dividend payments adds to its appeal. Find out the company’s ranking on our blue-chip dividend stocks list.

headlines.title: Lowe’s Keeps Raising Its Dividend. A Frozen Housing Market Could Test That Streak
headlines.summary: Lowe's has doubled its quarterly dividend since 2021 and still outpaces Home Depot and Target on payout growth, but a frozen housing market and fresh acquisition debt are now squeezing the engine that makes those raises possible.

headlines.title: Lowe's AI-Driven Holiday Push and E-Commerce Spend Might Change The Case For Investing In Lowe's Companies (LOW)
headlines.summary: Lowe's recently highlighted past investments of about US$542.00 million in Q2 fiscal 2026 to upgrade its digital and fulfillment capabilities, while also rolling out extended Black Friday and holiday promotions supported by its Mylow AI assistant to attract both DIY and professional customers.

description: Lowe's Companies, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, operates as a home improvement retailer in the United States and Canada. It provides a line of products for construction, maintenance, repair, remodeling, and decorating. The company also offers home improvement products, such as appliances, seasonal and outdoor living, lumber, lawn and garden, kitchens and bath, hardware, building materials, millwork, paint, rough plumbing, tools, electrical, flooring, and décor. In addition, it provides installation services through independent contractors in various product categories; and extended protection plans and repair services. Further, the company provides design, distribution, and installation services for interior surface finishes to home builders and property managers. It sells its national brand-name merchandise and private brand products to professional customers, individual homeowners, and renters. The company serves its products through Lowes.com website, mobile applications, retail home improvement stores and outlet stores, and its branches. Lowe's Companies, Inc. was founded in 1921 and is based in Mooresville, North Carolina.
